objects.summary: P2 Q30 review finds B2 rows are regenerated with current lane_definitions/walk_forward/StrategySpec rather than frozen historical generators or a published row identity; current-code drift could silently change the supposedly historical diagnostic.

P1 F1 review finds Stage B trusts any Stage A JSON with stage tag and valid selected_theta, without authenticating harness hash/cells/result digest; tampering selected_theta could consume the sealed Stage B on the wrong cell.

P1 F2 review finds assembled markets/candles/fees/categories are analyzed without rechecking acquisition hashes; immutable capture manifest must travel with assembled inputs and every file must be verified before the single analysis.

P2 F1 review finds forced exits reuse entry-time slippage even if a symbol's liquidity rank changed; R12 requires slippage classification at the actual forced-exit date, otherwise NAV and potentially verdict are wrong.

P2 watchdog review finds total team silence is invisible when msgs is empty because silence alert requires newest message; with open work, PR creation or queue-update time must seed the silence clock.

cross_object_findings.finding: A diagnostic cannot claim to reuse historical B2 rows if it regenerates them through mutable current code. Freeze the generator dependency set or bind reconstructed rows to a published historical identity.
A sealed confirmatory stage must verify the exact Stage A result/harness/cells or independently recompute the selection from authenticated cells before consuming the one-use Stage B data.
Hashing raw acquisition is insufficient if assembly drops the manifest and analysis no longer validates byte identities. The provenance chain must survive acquisition -> assembly -> analysis.
Exit costs tied to liquidity rank must use the state at forced exit, not entry-time cached classification, or economic P&L can be biased.
A liveness monitor that needs a previous team message cannot detect the strongest failure mode: open work with no agent activity at all. A durable external time anchor is required.
